frozen_scope: Existing native mathematical protocols; no new spin/coupling law, physical cost units or universal minimality.

tasks.endpoint_only: Arbitrary raw coefficient input x; output the final native return N x. Intermediate states and source-mode interventions are not in this task.
tasks.retained_stage: Same raw domain, with the actual L-stage output available as a reader, and original stage/source records retained. Must not identify states distinguished by L x.
tasks.return_image_only: Earlier normalized im(N) extraction domain. The broader raw-input hostile does not refute that scoped extraction.

factor_candidate: Use actual encoder K and decoder D with DK=I_rank and KD=N; no approximation or basis change to the raw output.

cost_policy.unit: one retained nonzero coefficient occurrence in the explicitly materialized operator tables
cost_policy.native_tables: sum of supports of the stored L,G,N tables
cost_policy.cold_full_archive_plus_factors: count the complete original L/G/N coefficient archive PLUS the new factor occurrences; a digest/reference is not an implementation of dereferencing
cost_policy.warm_shared_archive: the original library archive is charged once globally; per-use new factor tables may share it, but their small count is not cold total-certificate cost
cost_policy.not_charged: metadata, arithmetic bit length, primitive hardware resources and source-constructor derivation cost are outside this declared coefficient-occurrence metric
cost_policy.sharing: No sharing between distinct materialized table occurrences within the cold count. Different policies require explicit review.
cost_policy.minimality: Only explicit constructions and counterexamples; no claim of minimum.

hostiles.stage_erasure: Choose x=(L-N)e_j nonzero. Then Dx=0=Nx but Lx=x, so the factor latent of x equals that of zero while the L reader differs.
hostiles.archive_erasure: Do not report support(K)+support(D) as the complete archive cost when retaining the old stage tables.
hostiles.count_identification: Compare J(n) groups to actual L/G/N supports under the common full-normalized-return convention, not different conventions selected to recover1836.

acceptance: Exact endpoint equality and an explicit counterexample or witness for retained-stage sufficiency, with all table/archive counts and the count-identification scope exported.
